updates.title: Endpoint DLP Now Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP has reached general availability for monitoring sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols from managed Windows devices, with enforcement of restrictive actions to prevent exfiltration. Admins can now configure FTP and SFTP transfer activities directly in their Endpoint DLP policies to protect data in transit across these common file transfer protocols.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security Integrates with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Purview Network Data Security now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce DLP policies at the network layer and detect risky user activity through Insider Risk Management. This integration protects sensitive text, files, and AI interactions while preventing data sharing with untrusted cloud applications across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms.

updates.title: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Reporting Available
updates.summary: Administrators can now generate an Information Barriers policy compliance report to identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer meet policy requirements after changes are made. This reporting capability simplifies the audit and remediation process for organizations managing information barriers across their Microsoft 365 environment.
